correctness.rationale: Reconstructed F_N from independent Bernoulli clocks, positive derivative L and variance V, Lyapunov third-moment O(N^-1/2), and inversion through P(W_N<=u)=P(M_N(u)>theta). Verified generalized harmonic-sum Euler–Maclaurin, uniform endpoint-smoothed Riemann sums, D_s(a)=(J_s(a)-e^-a)/s, unique cancellation root, B2 sign and exact theta ranges. Independent quadrature and root-finding at s=.3,.5,.7 and theta=.4 gave scaled finite drifts .33072,.40645,.44426 versus predicted .31821,.40576,.43335 at N=16000, consistent with finite corrections; they do not prove the CLT. No assertion at s=0,1 or moving parameters.

Chebunin–Zuyev and Karlin analyze fixed infinite-frequency urns; other published SCOPE quorums use homogeneous clocks or s=1, not this finite aligned s<1 case. value.rationale: Sharp distinction between exact and simpler constant centering in a natural previously studied probabilistic model; identifies whether the difference changes Gaussian mean, destroys tightness, or disappears, plus a nontrivial parameter-tuned second threshold. Useful for correct probabilistic approximation, not just an ordinary CLT.

final_claim: For any fixed 0<s<1 and 0<theta<1 in finite aligned-Zipf first-discovery quorums, sqrt(N)(W_N-u_N) is asymptotically N(0,V/L^2); the deterministic center has a first drift B1 N^(s-1) with unique sign-zero quorum theta0(s). Outside theta0 the first centering threshold is s=1/2; on theta0 the B2<0 drift creates a second critical threshold s=3/4.
limitations: Fixed s in (0,1), theta in (0,1), lambda positive and independent exponential clocks; no unpoissonized/discrete-time or moment convergence claims; priority best-of-knowledge not absolute.
